India began their Women’s Asia Cup 2026 campaign against Thailand at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium, with India batting first after losing the toss.

Aunt May’s “With great power...” speech fundamentally defined Peter’s journey, but internet meme creators clearly have zero mercy when it comes to classic Spider-Man trauma. Is this pun elite tier humor or did it cross the line?

The evolution is actually insane🤯

From low-poly seagulls to birds that look like they could fly straight out of a nature documentary. Rockstar really keeps pushing realism to another level.

The post is a reply praising Rockstar’s graphics evolution in the GTA series, noting the shift from GTA IV’s low-poly seagulls in 2008 to near-photorealistic birds in the GTA VI trailer that resemble real nature footage.

It reacts to a three-panel image comparing seagull models across GTA IV (2008), GTA V (2013), and GTA VI (2026), with the original poster commenting that GTA V’s version appears most natural.

The commenter highlights Rockstar’s ongoing push for hyper-realism in open-world environments, using humor to underscore the “insane” level of detail advancement in virtual wildlife.
